data.headline: Microsoft Cloud & Power Platform Specialist | M365 | CoE | AI & Copilot
data.about:
With over 18 years in the IT industry, I bring deep expertise in designing and implementing enterprise solutions using Content Management Systems, Microsoft Cloud, and low-code technologies. For the past 7 years, I’ve specialized in the Microsoft Power Platform—delivering impactful solutions with Power BI, Power Apps, Power Automate, SharePoint Online, M365, PowerShell, and Azure.

My journey includes leading cloud migration projects and driving digital transformation initiatives. Currently, I’m focused on the rollout of Microsoft Copilot and AI-powered agents.

description.text:
Part of M365 Digital Workplace Solutions Team at ICA Sverige. Works mainly with Copilot Rollout and Governance, Power Platform Administration and Governance and CoE Developer.

Responsibilities:
1) Setting up and managing environments within the Power Platform ecosystem.
2) Implementing security and data loss prevention (DLP) policies.
3) Providing administration, monitoring, development, and user support.
4) Creating and managing solutions using Power BI, Fabric, Power Apps and Flows.
5) Collaborating with business users and developers with Hands on coaching.
6) Managing licensing and capacity.
7) Managing CoE solution and developing new dashboards using CoE data.
8) Ensuring compliance with governance policies and best practices
9) Participating in M365 Architecture forum.

This Project is to migrate content (around 4 million) from existing ECM provider to SharePoint and then provide after support in SharePoint.
We executed the project using 3 step procedure Extract, Load and Transform. 
We developed a custom solution to extract all documents along with metadata and permissions from Oracle system to Interim fileshare and database. We used ShareGate tool to Load content from fileshare to SharePoint. Developed custom powershell script to transform imported content in various SharePoint sites with permissions and metadata. Performed various roles in the project as Migration Architect and SharePoint Developer and currently working as SharePoint Administrator.

Job Responsibilities:
1) Designed and implemented the Migration Strategy, that includes Solution design, planning and execution.
2) Part of 6 member Migration Team.
3) Ability to write Migration reports, write complex SQL queries, and ability to analyze the SQL data.
4) Design and creation of SharePoint Online document center templates.
5) Design and created content types for document templates, meta data, views, and security policies.
6) Manage Sites, OneDrives, user profiles, security and compliance, eDiscovery using Admin center.
7) Worked with AIP labels, AAD sync from Azure portal.
8) Ability in writing basic level powershell scripting that involves connecting to SharePoint Online and working with documents and also AzureAD module for user validation.
9) Able to manage Onsite and Offshore resources.

Technical Owner for Document Management application at ICA as an Infosys consultant. 
Leading delivery, application maintenance, application development, deployment and management activities.
Participate in business and system requirements sessions, proactively identify scope changes and come up with the estimates. 
Understand business requirements and provide solutions.
Working closely with different business units within ICA provide specific solutions.
Involved in Webcenter Content upgrade (PS7 to PS8) and patching activities.
Leading the Development team and followed the agile methodology, understanding of the requirement till testing (SDLC phase).
Customization on Desktop Integration Suite and client roll out.

Involved in designing and implementing Oracle Webcenter solution to automate Account Payable business process for Diebold. Worked on ODC, OFR and IPM implementations of the project. Also	developed AXF scripts which will create profiles for Invoice Processing Tasklist Page.
Also invovled in executing 2 migration projects for Avaya, which involves migrating documents from Panagon FileNet services and FileNet P8 systems to Oracle Webcenter content. 
Designed and development Custom Migration Tool that can extract Documents and metadata (including security) from Legacy ECM (FileNet) and import in Oracle WebCenter Content. Also involved in installation and setup of Oracle Webcenter Content environment.

Involved in Design and development of ECM and BPM solution for AON Reinsurer document management solution. Involved in development and support using FileNet 4.5 (CE, PE and AE), eForms, widgets, IBM Content Collector and JMS.

Involved in designing and developing Business Process Management (BPM) solution for Allianz BE’s External Claims business process. Lombardi Teamworks is used to fulfill the business process orchestration and task management requirements of the solution.

	Involved in supporting Ice cold plus, a custom java application which connects to Panagon Reports Manager
	Involved in designing and developing Change Requests.
	Resolving tickets using Remedy Action Request System.
	Involved in effective communication with users, clients in resolving problem tickets.

	Part of 6-member development team, which built the product from design to development of the application using FileNet 3.5 (CE, PE, AE), Ascent Capture and Java components.
	Lead FileNet Capture Module
	Involved in the development of Content Engine and Process Engine configurations.
	Involved in the development of a user friendly GUI and the landing page of the application.
	Involved in development of Document Inquiry Application (Search Application)
	Involved in Application support and maintenance Activities.
